label: Jaki
title: 邪気
meaning: Malice, bad feeling 悪い気、悪気、悪意
meaning_example: Have a bad feeling getting up sick.　（Formal)

notes.text: I'm not familiar with the word, but it says it's read as "Jiyaki" yet the kana clearly says "Hyaki" or "Hiyaki"...(I cannot tell if the "ya" is small or regular...)

notes.text:
Should be Jaki 邪気

Def:【名】

①　病気などを引き起こす悪い気。悪気。

②　拗けた気持ち。悪意。わるぎ。

English Def Malice, bad feeling (such as when you get up when your sick etc.
